newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ROKISHKIS APPLIES FOR TOP BOURSE LIST.
newsitem.headline: ROKISHKIS APPLIES FOR TOP BOURSE LIST.

text.p: Lithuania's Rokishkis Cheese (RC) said on Thursday it had applied to the national stock exchange to be registered on its official trading list.

"Rokishkis Cheese submitted its application to register its 1,625,733 shares with face value of ten litas on the national stock exchange's official list," company economist Grazina Jankauskiene told Reuters in a telephone interview.
The Vilnius bourse said earlier it intended to form an official trading list in the next two weeks.
The bourse said that other candidates to the official list of the bourse were packaging company Medienos Plaushas and Vilniaus and Hermis banks.
"The share capital of RC now is 30.24 million litas," Jankauskiene added.
Jankauskiene said RC was 29.1 percent foreign owned and that 39 percent of stake of the company was the hands of its management.
Last Friday shareholders approved a dividend payment equal to 10 percent of the face value on ordinary shares and one percent of preference shares face value.
"The total sum to be paid in dividends is 1.8 million litas," Jankauskiene said.

The company also said its internationally audited net profit in 1996 was 10.5 million litas versus 12.9 million litas reported in an unaudited profit and balance sheet. The company said its 1995 net profit was 9.3 million litas.
The company said it expected a 17 million litas profit in 1997.
